messages:
alex: Kicking off blue/green handoff to green-v2 for edge-router pool. Change window 10:00-10:30 UTC, low traffic. I will coordinate traffic ramp. Checklist: pin client version, warm instances, run health probes, coordinate drain. @sanam you good to hold the rollout toggle?
sanam: Yup. I pinned the client-service to v2.3.1 in config-store and created a rollout tag. Also uploaded rollout notes to the console.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: edge-router green-v2 -> instances 12 -> target=green. Trigger: manual. Runbook: /runbooks/edge-handoff.md.
chris: Plan: 0 -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100%. Hold 3m between steps; auto-fail over to blue if p95 latency increases by >30% or 5xx rate >0.5%. Will verify KV cache warmup after 10% step.
kai: Additive: before first traffic shift, please run this quick health check from two regions: `curl -sS -I https://edge.example.com/healthz?variant=green` — expect 200 and X-Redwood-KV: warmed. Also ensure connection reuse metrics showing steady keepalive.
jordan: Observability hooks: dashboard slice 'edge/latency' (p50/p95/p99), 'edge/errors' (5xx by route), and 'router-kv/hit-rate'. I set alerts to quiet mode for the window except the canary triggers so we don't get noise.
sanam: Confirmed clients pinned. I also uploaded a small eval prompt set to Redwood Optimize to detect semantic regressions. If quality score drops >7 points we abort.
alex: Good. chris — start at 10:02 UTC. Call out when you hit 10%. I'll watch traffic and be ready to manual-drain. @sre-oncall you're on rollback escalation if triggers fire.
sre-oncall: Acknowledged. If rollback: run `infractl traffic shift --to=blue --percent=100 --force` and notify pagerduty. Also pre-approved to scale blue pool by +3 nodes if needed.
deploy-bot: ACTION: shifting traffic 0 -> 10% to green-v2 (operator: chris).
chris: Running command: `infractl traffic shift --pool edge --to green-v2 --percent 10 --timeout 180s`
chris: 10% done. KV warmup: header X-Redwood-KV=ready on 95% of calls. p95=42ms (baseline 38ms), 5xx=0.06% (baseline 0.03%). Holding for 3m.
jordan: Metrics look fine. No error spike. Logs show a couple of transient kv-miss errors but recovered.
chris: Moving to 25%. `infractl traffic bump --to 25`
chris: 25% done. p95=48ms (up ~26%), 5xx=0.12%. This is within our trigger thresholds but note p95 creeping. Recommend pause and increase cache prefill TTL for green to 2m.
ai note: (automated analysis) quality-check: evals set passed 97/100 prompts.
sanam: Increasing prefill TTL now. Also enabling HTTP keepalive pool=20 for green instances.
chris: After TTL bump and keepalive, p95 back to 40ms at 25%. Proceeding to 50%.
chris: 50% done. p95=45ms, 5xx=0.15%. No manual rollback. Keep an eye on memory growth on green pods — one node shows +12% RSS increase compared to blue.
\ai note: (deploy-bot) If memory growth continues to >20% vs baseline, automated rollback will execute.
alex: Noted. chris please slow next step to 5m hold. We don't want to hit auto rollback.
chris: Slowing. Next 75% will be manual after sign-off from @alex and @jordan.
jordan: Sign-off to proceed to 75% in 5m if memory stabilizes. Also I set a temporary trace-sampler=0.5 for green so we get traces without overload.
chris: 75% -> done. memory delta stabilized to +9%. p95=46ms, 5xx=0.13%. No regressions in evals.
sanam: Running final smoke: `curl -sS https://edge.example.com/healthz` from 6 regions, all 200.
chris: 100% shift in progress. `infractl traffic shift --to green-v2 --percent 100`
deploy-bot: ACTION: traffic shift to green-v2 at 100% initiated by chris. Estimated completion 45s.
deploy-bot: COMPLETE: traffic shift to green-v2 at 100% succeeded.
alex: Green pool at 100%. Leaving blue as standby and starting gentle drain: `infractl drain --pool blue --grace 300s`
sre-oncall: I'll keep standby ready to scale and will run rollback if signals degrade. Good job team. :thumbsup:
chris: Post-deploy notes: pinned config, rollout tags, and a short postmortem template saved to the console. No rollback required.
alex: Thanks all. I'll publish release notes and mark release window closed.
sanam: Added a quick note to the console about the cache TTL tweak and trace-sampler change.
jordan: Will watch overnight for memory trend; will open a follow-up ticket if it creeps.
alex: Closing thread. :tada:
